title: File:Balfour decleration march, Toronto 1917.jpg
author: Template:Courtesy Sara Edell Schaffler Kelman/Bill Gladstone
description: A march in 1917, possibly in support of the Balfour Declaration, in front of some unknown buildings (not the parliament building) in Toronto Canada. The man in the shiny black top hat is Rabbi Yosef Weinreb, the chief rabbi of Toronto at the time.
